title: Bounded flat universal cohomology models for quasi-compact separated morphisms
statement: Let f:X→T be quasi-compact and separated and F a quasi-coherent O_X-module flat over T. Assume injective resolutions in X.Modules. For each t∈T there exist an affine open U containing t, a natural number d, and a quasi-coherent complex C on U concentrated in [0,d], termwise flat over U, such that for every cartesian square with base map T′→U→T (and injective resolutions on X′), the homology of the ordinary pullback of C in degree q is isomorphic to R^q f′_* g′*F, for every q∈ℕ.

proof.text: Choose an affine open U containing t by exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset. Its inverse image is compact by f.isCompact_preimage. Use its affineCover.finiteSubcover and reindex by Fin r using Fintype.equivFin. Its opensRange family is a covering by affine opens. Apply isFlatOver_affineOpenRestriction to F and the affine open U. Transport its flatness along the inverse of overFunctorEquiv, evaluated on each affine open with scalars restricted along appLE, using Module.Flat.equiv_iff. Postcompose the resulting base map with the inverse spectrum-chart isomorphism: its app map is a ring isomorphism, hence flat by RingHom.Flat.of_bijective; Module.Flat.trans and comp_appLE transport flatness back to f restricted to U. Simplify the chart followed by its inverse.

Use the actual complex C=finiteAffineCechModel (f restricted to U) (F restricted to the inverse image) V, and d=r. The proved construction properties give the lower and upper bounds and quasi-coherence of every term. The flatness lemma, applied to the restricted flatness just proved, gives IsFlatOver of the identity in every degree.

Apply the comparison for this specified complex, affine open, and affine cover to obtain the required isomorphism for every supplied cartesian square and every q. Combine the bounds, flatness and quasi-coherence with this comparison in the existential conclusion.

theorem exists_proper_flat_cohomology_model_data {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules)
    [IsSeparated f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [HasInjectiveResolutions X.Modules] [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hF : F.IsFlatOver f) (t : T) :
    ∃ (U : T.Opens) (C : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ),
      t ∈ U ∧ IsAffine U.toScheme ∧ C.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ C.IsStrictlyLE d ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 U.toScheme)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent) ∧
      ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
        [HasInjectiveResolutions X'.Modules], IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι) → ∀ q : ℕ,
        Nonempty ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C).homology q ≅
          (higherDirectImage f' q).obj ((Modules.pullback g').obj F))
